notes.subject: sɔgɔdalaw sabanan
notes.rationale: Identity of the three shepherds is a famous unsolved crux: proposals include prophets, priests, and kings of Judah, or specific rulers; the text never names them.

notes.subject: saba ... kalo kelen
notes.rationale: Counting: three shepherds removed within one month — a numbered, bounded sign-act.

notes.subject: ni
notes.rationale: נפש rendered 'ni' (life/soul); literally 'my soul grew short (impatient)' — the idiom of patience as length.

notes.subject: dɔgɔyara
notes.rationale: קצר נפש 'short of soul' = impatient/weary; rendered with the literal 'grew short' to keep the picture.

translation: M'ye ⟨את⟩ sɔgɔdalaw sabanan tiŋɛ kalo kelen kɔnɔ; ne ni dɔgɔyara u la, ani u ni fana tun jugunna ne la.
